parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of `:meta public:` not affecting variables by modifying the `get_module_members` method. The changes are minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new method `get_module_members` in `__init__.py` which is not aligned with the existing style of the file. The method is also marked as deprecated in `importer.py`, which might be confusing.
The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the changes made. It would be helpful to add a note about the new method and its deprecation.
